example.title: Harbour bait, tackle and gift shop (Nautical Treasures), Santa Cruz Harbor
example.place: Santa Cruz, Santa Cruz County, CA

brief: A small 1970s harbourside bait shop: a single-storey timber shed with a deep shingled porch roof on posts, racks of rods and nets under the porch, a hand-carved sign ('ICE · BEER · GIFTS · SNACKS · BAIT & TACKLE') propped at the door. One photo (sepia). Placed on its pier over the water with piles 10 m below the bed (spec rule 4).
